Oh my, is that a crywank review bomb I spy? What ever could it be for I wonder? - Oh right, the usual suspects are whinging with impotent rage over yet another epic games store exclusive. My what a wondrous display of gamer stupidity and unwarrent self-importance. 

But do keep on with it children, it is ever so amusing. 

Anyhow - as for BL2 - it's good, stupid loot hunting fun, though for me not as fun as Grim Dawn, which I have spent far, far too many hours with. Definitely worth trying out though and with the current bundle, ever so damn cheap too. So much so I'm tempted to get it just to get the pre-sequel and finish off the DLC collection. 

Though there are some minor issues - bullet sponge enemies, guns all too often feel off and can be a bit too grindy to get good ones, DLC sometimes outstays it's welcome. And the level of 00's internet style randomness may annoy certain people a lot. Also that skag-fluffer Handsome Jack can soo go die in a fire.

Edit - note, I reserve the right to delete non-funny responses, chan bs and baby's-first-troll-post comments, because let's face it, steam's enough of a garbage fire as it is and doesn't need adding to with further garbage. And yes, HIV based jokes are totes unfunny, and were so way back in 00's kids (if not the 90's ffs). Also, fixed some stuff - 2hrly nightsweats are not good for the brain.

Play it.

What are you doing?
Is it playing Borderlands 2?
If yes, good.
If no, buy Borderlands 2 and play it

Did you like the old game? TLDR Go for it.

Bad stuff
=======
Do you like running and running to get to your quest location?
Do you love invisible walls?
Are you absolutely nuts about getting nudged off cliffs by invisible map glitches to where you didn't want to go?
Do you like illogical maps and obstacles?
Do you like to be confused about how to get to a quest marker?
Do you like to run BACKWARDS to get back from your quest location?
Do you like not being able to teleport back from your quest location?
Basically, do you like a jogging simulator?

Good stuff
========
More guns. More shields. More loot. More DLC.
The new ammo/inventory upgrade system is much more fun.
This game will make you angry and frustrated and keep you coming back for more.

Yeah... they didn't fix bad stuff from the first game. It sucks. If you liked Borderlands, you'll probably like this one too. They did not learn jack shit from the last game, however. It still has all those old things you learned to hate about the old game. They saw the bugs, glitches and annoyances, and said "Fuck it, lets add more guns".

If more of the same is your game, then go for it. If you like things to get better, go elsewhere.

After playing a while, I do think this is probably a better game than Borderlands (number 1), and its fun. But GOD DAMN IT they could have fixed the map system. It is NOT FUN to stand around trying to figure out how to get to a quest marker with their shitty maps.

Where do I start with this game?

Well, I'll try to do my best in reviewing this game (I'm on my 2nd playthrough in TVHM). I've had this game for some time now and am just now reviewing it because of the release of Borderlands 3 (which unfortunately will be and EGS exclusive for sometime). The gameplay and story are amazing, and it has a special set of graphics. What I mean by this is that it's graphics may appear cartoony on the outside, however, they're somehow set that no matter how old this game is, it won't appear that outdated. Each set of characters have their own abilities which make them unique in their own way, and with these set of characters, there is no way for someone to say which characters are better as they all compliment a different playstyle. If you are going to get Borderlands 2, then definitely get the GOTY edition as the DLC's in this game are incredible. Heck, even get it on a sale for around $8. 

Overall, there's just so much with Borderlands 2 that make it unique and allow for much replayability.
